# Citation schema

The bundled CFF 1.2.0 JSON Schema is from
https://github.com/citation-file-format/citation-file-format/blob/1.2.0/schema.json

SHA256: `0b8d22140da702d766df318dcff3a91af2f39521298dcf36d76315fd99cc169b`.
The upstream license is retained in `citation-schema.LICENSE`.
It is bundled so citation validation does not require network access.
